paper.title: Little Red Dots: Rapidly Growing Black Holes Reddened by Extended Dusty Flows

result.summary: 本文针对 JWST 发现的小红点（LRD）的 V 形光谱能量分布（SED）提出一个从静止系紫外到红外的 SED 模型 [S1.p6][S5.p2]。模型假设 AGN 的入射辐射被一个延展的尘埃介质包裹，其消光律类似猎户座星云等致密区域，紫外-光学谱由尘埃衰减的 AGN 辐射描述，红外则由延展尘埃气体分布塑造 [S1.p6][S5.p2]。该模型无需额外的恒星辐射或 AGN 散射光，即可产生与 JWST MIRI 观测一致的平坦红外 SED [S1.p6][S5.p2]。作者据此讨论了 LRD 在 z>4 的出现、V 形 SED 的普遍性以及早期黑洞的宇宙学演化 [S1.p6]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的核心问题是 LRD 特征性 V 形 SED 的起源，即其静止系光学红色连续谱与紫外蓝色（或平坦）过剩的相对贡献来自星系还是 AGN [S1.p2]。观测显示多数 LRD 在 JWST/MIRI F1800W 波段未被探测到，且 MIRI SED 从静止系光学到近红外趋于平坦，这与被 AGN 加热的热尘埃应导致光学到近红外极红 SED 的预期相矛盾 [S1.p3]。LRD 在宇宙体积中的丰度显著高于地面类星体巡天预期，对类星体光度函数的宇宙学演化、宇宙再电离以及高红移黑洞自旋有重要意义 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Despite their significance, the properties of these newly identified LRDs remain puzzling, particularly concerning the origin of their characteristic v-shaped spectral energy distribution (SED).

Observational studies using SED template fitting suggested that the red optical part could either be due to dust-reddened AGNs or starburst galaxies, while the blue UV component might represent light from unobscured galaxies or scattered light from embedded AGNs.
Data from the JADES, COSMOS-Web and PRIMER-COSMOS surveys show that most LRDs are not detected in the JWST/MIRI F1800W bands
Those observations appear to contradict expectations that the SED should be very red throughout the optical to NIR spectrum due to re-emission from hot dust components heated by the AGNs.

The abundance of these AGNs in cosmic volume is significantly higher than what is expected from ground-based quasar surveys, and provides insights on the cosmological evolution of quasar luminosity functions, the impact on cosmic reionization, and the implications to rapid spins of these high-redshift BHs

method.text: 论文提出一个从静止系紫外到红外的 LRD SED 模型，假设具有典型 SED 的 AGN 入射辐射被延展尘埃介质包裹，其消光律类似猎户座星云或某些 AGN 环境 [S1.p6]。紫外-光学谱由尘埃衰减的 AGN 辐射描述，在 λ>4000 Å 呈红色光学连续谱，在 λ<3000 Å 因缺少小尺寸尘埃颗粒而通过灰色消光曲线形成平坦紫外谱，无需额外恒星辐射或 AGN 散射光 [S5.p2]。红外部分由径向密度剖面 ρ=ρ0(r/rin)^(-γ)（0<γ<2）的延展尘埃气体分布塑造，通过平衡尘埃加热与热辐射冷却确定尘埃温度，并计算尘埃再发射光度 [S3.p3][S3.p4]。模型还考虑辐射压反馈将升华半径附近的热尘埃推至光球半径，使近红外发射向中红外移动 [S3.p5]。

evidence.quote: We hypothesize that the incident radiation from an AGN, characterized by a typical SED, is embedded in an extended dusty medium with an extinction law similar to those seen in dense regions such as Orion Nebula or certain AGN environments.

The UV-optical spectrum is described by dust-attenuated AGN emission with $A_{\rm V}\simeq 3$ mag, featuring a red optical continuum at $\lambda>4000~{\rm\AA}$ and a flat UV spectral shape established through a gray extinction curve at $\lambda<3000~{\rm\AA}$, due to the absence of small-size grains.
In this scenario, there is no need for additional stellar emission or AGN scattered light.

we focus not only on a compact dust structure such as a dust torus, but rather a more extended dust structure described by a radial density profile of $\rho=\rho_{0}(r/r_{\rm in})^{-\gamma}$, where $\rho_{0}$ is the gas density at the sublimation radius $r_{\rm in}$, and the power-law index ranges $0<\gamma<2$.
the temperature of dust grains, $T_{\rm dust}(r)$, can be determined by balancing dust heating from irradiation with cooling through thermal emission
Radiation pressure expels dust grains between the sublimation radius and the dust photosphere to UV radiation into a thin shell that accumulates at $r=r_{\rm ph}$
As a result of the feedback, hot dust just behind the sublimation radius $r_{\rm in}$ is pushed to larger radii and becomes cooler, shifting the NIR emission to MIR.

experiments.text: 论文将模型 SED 与 JADES 和 COSMOS-Web 巡天的 LRD 堆叠测光数据比较，并采用 SCUBA 和 ALMA 波段未探测给出的中远红外流量上限作为约束 [S3.F4]。模型考察了升华半径处气体密度 1≤n0/cm^-3≤10^3（固定 γ=0）以及不同密度斜率 γ 对 SED 形状的影响 [S3.p7][S3.F4]。此外还计算了不同 AGN 流量贡献 f_AGN=10% 到 100%（γ=0.5）时对密度归一化的约束 [S4.SS2.p2]。

evidence.quote: The stacked photometric data of LRDs are taken from the JADES survey and the COSMOS-Web survey, and the upper bounds of the mid- to far-IR flux densities due to non-detection in SCUBA and ALMA bands are taken from.
we show the dependence of the SED shape on the gas density ( $1\leq n_{0}/{\rm cm}^{-3}\leq 10^{3}$) at the sublimation radius, while the slope of its radial profile is fixed to $\gamma=0$.
Right panel: Variation of SEDs with different density slopes $\gamma$.
The left panel of Figure 7 shows the SEDs modeled with $\gamma=0.5$ for various AGN flux contributions from $f_{\rm AGN}=10\%$ to $100\%$.

findings.text: 当密度高达 n0=10^3 cm^-3 时，再处理红外谱从 λ≈1 μm 开始上升并呈现覆盖 λ≈2-15 μm 的近中红外峰，使 SED 从 λ≈6000 Å 到约 2 μm 显著变红，但这与 JWST MIRI 对 LRD 的测光数据不符 [S3.p7]。γ=0 且 n0<10^3 cm^-3 的模型与 F1800W 测光上限一致 [S3.p9]。密度越不集中（γ<1），能量峰从近红外移向中红外 [S3.F4]。考虑辐射反馈的模型比无反馈模型预测更暗的近红外发射，因为无反馈时升华半径处的热尘埃层对近红外贡献显著 [S3.p11]。仅关注 AGN 的 SED 模型能成功再现 LRD 的 V 形 SED 和适度的近红外发射，且不排除宿主星系的存在 [S4.SS2.p5]。

evidence.quote: When the density is as high as $n_{0}=10^{3}~{\rm cm}^{-3}$, the outer edge of the obscuring material is located at $r_{\rm out}\gtrsim 30~r_{\rm in}$, where the dust temperature ranges from $T_{\rm dust}\simeq 1500~{\rm K}$ to $\sim 200~{\rm K}$.
the reprocessed IR spectrum begins to rise from $\lambda\simeq 1~\mu{\rm m}$ and exhibits a near- to mid-infrared bump that covers $\lambda\simeq 2-15~\mu{\rm m}$.
However, this extremely red SED color does not match the JWST MIRI photometric data for LRDs, which suggest a modest red color or even a flat spectral shape.
We also observe that our SED model with $\gamma=0$ and $n_{0}<10^{3}~{\rm cm}^{-3}$ aligns with the upper bounds of the F1800W photometry.
As the density is less concentrated ( $\gamma<1$), the energy peak shifts from the NIR to the MIR regime.

The feedback-free model predict brighter NIR emission compared to the models with feedback, because without feedback the hot dust layers at the sublimation radius contributes significantly to the NIR emission.

our approach does not rule out the existence of host galaxies in LRDs, but demonstrates that the SED model focusing only on AGNs successfully captures the characteristic spectral properties of LRDs: (1) the v-shaped SED in rest-frame UV to optical bands and (2) modest NIR emission.

limitations.text: 作者指出，LRD 为何在 z>4 以统一的 A_V=3 mag 消光水平出现，目前没有明确答案，只能给出推测 [S4.SS4.p1]。模型中假设全天覆盖（C≡Ω/4π=1），该值需在 LRD 与未遮蔽 AGN 的相对宇宙丰度及 C 对 Eddington 比等 AGN 性质的依赖被更好理解后才能确定 [S3.p4]。尘埃再发射公式仅在光学薄极限下适用 [S3.p4]。关于尘埃散射导致 AGN 变异性减弱的定量分析留待未来工作 [S4.SS3.p2]。

evidence.quote: There is a critical question: Why do LRDs emerge at $z>4$ with a uniform extinction level of $A_{\rm V}=3$ mag? There is no clear answer to this question at this time, but some speculations are given below.

In our calculation, we assume a full-sky covering case (i.e., $C\equiv\Omega/4\pi=1$), while this value will be determined when the relative cosmic abundance between LRDs and unobscured AGNs and the dependence of $C$ on the AGN properties such as the Eddington ratio are better understood for LRDs.
Note that the equation ( 3) can be applied in the optically thin limit of dust re-emission in the dusty surrounding medium.
A more detailed quantitative analysis of this scenario will be explored in future work.
